errors.claim: The entrepreneurial journey is structured around a venture life cycle of seed, early stage, maturity, and harvest, with rebirth as an option.
searches: venture life cycle|company lifecycle|funding grows generally through three stages
errors.source_check: The source gives a nine-stage venture life cycle (startup, development, resourcing, market entry, growth, maturity, harvest, exit, rebirth) and separately a three-stage funding cycle of seed, early stage, and maturity. The reference conflates them.
errors.suggested_fix: correct to the nine-stage venture life cycle and distinguish it from the three-stage funding cycle

errors.claim: Successful ventures move through a problem-solution-fit phase, then a product-market-fit phase, then a scale phase.
errors.source_check: The source presents problem/solution fit and product-market fit as complementary early-validation frames. A named scale phase and this three-phase sequence are absent.
errors.suggested_fix: delete the scale-phase sequence and state only that the source presents problem/solution fit and product-market fit as complementary frames

errors.claim: Four eras structure the historical narrative: Colonial and Early America, First Industrial Revolution, Second Industrial Revolution, Interwar and Postwar America, and the Knowledge Economy.

errors.suggested_fix: correct to five eras

errors.claim: Three canvases are introduced, and the Lean Canvas replaces key activities, key partners, and key resources with problem, solution, and key metrics.

value proposition canvas|mission model canvas|social lean canvas
gone are the customer relationships|Unfair Advantage|problems, solutions, and key metrics
errors.source_check: The section centres its learning objectives on three canvases but also introduces the value proposition, mission model, and social lean canvases. It also says the Lean Canvas removes customer relationships, key activities, key partners, and key resources and adds problem, solution, unfair advantage, and key metrics.
errors.suggested_fix: correct to three focal canvases plus the additional variants, and include customer relationships and unfair advantage in the Lean Canvas changes

errors.claim: The startup operational plan typically covers eight elements: business operations, vendor selection, supply chain, technology infrastructure, payment systems, inventory management, customer service systems, and quality control.

errors.suggested_fix: correct to the five operations-management areas or summarise the twenty-item checklist without an invented eight-item taxonomy

errors.suggested_fix: correct to first decide who should benefit, then decide for-profit versus not-for-profit status

errors.claim: Closed corporations are owned by five or fewer individuals controlling more than 50 per cent of outstanding stock during the last half of the tax year.

errors.suggested_fix: correct to identification, assessment, and abatement, with incorporation, limited-liability structures, financial planning, and insurance as discussed protections

errors.claim: Trade secrets are "weaker than patents but unlimited in duration as long as the secret is not revealed".

trade secret is not limited in duration/time
continue indefinitely as long as the secret is not revealed
